comments:
The "old temple" of Rin chen sgang was founded in 1119, whereas the "new temple" and other structures were built in 1182 by his nephew. See [7JUD7TIJ]: 484, n. 19.
The institution was famed for being a repository of the instruction of bka' gdams pa oral precepts (man ngag) ([2X2E3882]: 272, n. 169).
